name: OrthoGait Clean
summary:
OrthoGait Clean is a movement-study and documentation workspace for Meta Quest.

Analyze a selected image, use supported outward-facing cameras for body or face landmark detection, review saved sessions, compare repeated assessments and export PDF or CSV reports. Bundled MediaPipe Lite, Full and Heavy body models are available.
